description: Maps the customer's own words to a Bidit category. Returns petal_id, whether the category accepts requests (accepting_requests), field values found in the text (prefilled_fields) and the required fields still missing (missing_required). If nothing matches confidently it returns the list of categories instead. Health is web-only and returns a message instead of a form.

region.description: Region or city if the customer mentioned one.
region.title: Region
